Message:
This flower was the one thing
she left me in her final moments.
The flower that
would’ve let me die.

Now, no matter how
gently I stroke it,
I can’t feel her warmth
or gentle smile anymore.

But, that’s okay.
Because the essence of
your heart remains inside me.

I unsewed the black flower
from its place near my heart,
and quietly set it down
on the table...

Then, the next day...
the once-withered flower was
blooming even brighter
than it ever had.

...Haah. There you go again,
completely ignoring how I feel...
Honestly, you really are
a selfish person.

I take the white flower
into my hand,
holding it up like
how I’ve always done.

The wind doesn’t blow,
yet it sways back and forth.

And for a moment,
I catch a faint, yet familiar scent.
